_comment: Measured 2026-10-31 against REAL Cursor agent transcripts on this machine under ~/.cursor/projects/<slug>/agent-transcripts/<uuid>/<uuid>.jsonl. Each line is { role, message: { content: [...] } }; tool calls are type tool_use with name + input (Write/StrReplace take input.path, Shell takes input.command). No line carries a clock, a model, a cwd or a session id — those stay absent rather than invented. Human turns wrap the real request in <user_query>…</user_query> (often after a <timestamp>…</timestamp> that is prose, not ISO).
_eventTime: Cursor never writes a per-line timestamp. lastEventAt is the file's mtime (ISO), which is what the harness actually updates when it appends. Declared as eventTime rather than a fake fields.timestamp path: a path that never matches would look like format drift.
_mark: TRACED from Cursor's own product icon, never drawn: the path in CursorIcon inside resources/app/molten/dist/renderer/assets (viewBox 0 0 49 56), scaled uniformly by 24/56 and centred on x into a 24-unit badge. Tint is near-white so the mark reads on Ariadne's dark hub; Cursor ships the same silhouette in currentColor. The day an official SVG asset is redistributable under a clear licence it can replace this field with no code change.
_tree: Two layouts, one declaration. Under ~/.cursor/projects each first-level directory is a project slug holding agent-transcripts/<sessionId>/<sessionId>.jsonl — nest session-dir says the jsonl sits in a child of subPath, not in subPath itself. Pointing the picker at a single project's agent-transcripts folder still works: the walk falls through to treating each child as a session directory. idFrom dir because no line carries a session id.
_fields: No model, cwd, branch or sessionId on any measured line. Absent stays absent. sessionId comes from the directory name via tree.idFrom.
_artifact: Write creates a file; StrReplace edits one. Both carry the absolute path in input.path. Measured on a real session: Write 2, StrReplace 29, against Shell 121 — most edits are StrReplace. Delete is not listed: removing a file is not writing one.
_shellWrite: Shell is the terminal tool. The command string is input.command. Patterns stay in lib/shellWrites — a connector is data a stranger can ship.
_humanTurn: role:user is the person. Measured: zero tool_result blocks on user lines in the real transcripts (unlike Claude Code), but notWhen stays so a format change cannot flood the summary. between pulls the request out of <user_query>…</user_query>; when the markers are absent the raw text is kept.
